novel_features.name: Domain rank check
novel_features.description: See the position of a domain for a query, optionally from a specific country, in one call.
novel_features.rationale: Scans the live result list for the domain and reports its position; no Serply endpoint answers that question directly.
novel_features.example: serply-pp-cli rank github.com --q "open source cli" --x-proxy-location US --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this instead of a raw web search when the task is where a site ranks, not what the results are.

novel_features.name: SERP change diff
novel_features.description: See which URLs entered, left, or moved in a results page since the last time you ran the same query.
novel_features.rationale: Compares against a locally stored snapshot of the same query and location; the API keeps no history.
novel_features.example: serply-pp-cli serp diff --q "best static site generator" --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it for recurring monitoring of a query; the first run stores a baseline and later runs report only what changed.

novel_features.name: Cited research brief
novel_features.description: Get one deduplicated, numbered source list for a topic from web, news and scholar results at once.
novel_features.rationale: Fans out to three verticals concurrently and merges them into one citation list; no endpoint combines verticals.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an answer needs sources of more than one kind, such as current coverage plus papers.

narrative.headline: Live Google, News, Scholar, Maps and Bing results, plus rank checks, SERP diffs and cited research briefs.
narrative.value_prop: Nine Serply search verticals as typed commands and MCP tools, with per-country proxies and device emulation on each. On top, rank finds a domain's position for a query, serp diff reports what moved since the last run, and research merges web, news and scholar results into one cited brief.

quickstart.comment: Check the install and config without spending credits
Recent coverage from one Google News edition
Where a domain ranks for a query
A cited brief across web, news and scholar

troubleshoots.fix: export SERPLY_API_KEY=<your key from serply.io>, then run serply-pp-cli doctor
Top up at https://serply.io; cached repeat queries stay free

troubleshoots.symptom: Results look like the wrong country
troubleshoots.fix: Pass --x-proxy-location GB (or another two-letter code) and --gl gb

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent or script needs live search engine results: Google web, News, Scholar, Images, Video, Jobs, Shopping, Maps, or Bing. It fits grounding answers in current sources, checking where a site ranks from a given country, and watching a results page for changes over time.
anti_triggers: Do not use it to read the full text of a page; it returns result titles, links and snippets.
Do not use it for semantic or embedding search over your own documents.
Do not loop it over hundreds of queries without checking credit cost first; every uncached call is billed.
